$comment: MACHINE half of the code reviewer's entry point; the HUMAN half (why/when, decision tables) is dispatch.md. `x-requirements` couples shapes to requirement IDs (rule 7). No spec gate runs over this directory yet (specs/README.md, the root-pair gap).

project.description: repo name; the slug defaults to teststuffstash/<project>

model.description: --model: the hand-run override; keeps the review off the gateway (REVIEW-ADMIT-GATEWAY)

loop_ns.description: --loop-ns: the pod runs in this ns as agentstack-loop

decorrelate_from.description: the author's served model family — evidence only at the gateway

exit.description: 0 = a quiet refusal (opt-out, SLO teeth, currency, gateway defer) or the pod exited 0; 1 = FATAL before the pod (a part that does not parse, a brief without TOOL_GAP_SURFACES:) or an unreadable pod phase; 2 = unknown arg; 3 = pod create refused; any other = the pod's own exit (10 = no terminal, verdict.schema.json)
predicate: 0 dispatch, 1 skip (opted out OR the claims read failed — fail closed); 2 usage

proceeds.description: false iff state is non-empty and != OPEN, or mergeStateStatus == DIRTY

touches_escapes.description: the value interpolated as `TOUCHES-ESCAPES: <v>` into the model's prompt

oneOf.description: the escaped paths, one per line, sorted; governance paths prefixed

review_perstack.description: the `review-perstack` trigger's Workflow parameters; fires only when body.loop_ns matches `.+`

task.description: TASK_KEY when the dispatcher sets one

request.$comment: the shape is the gateway's post.input (gateway/specs/endpoints/sessions.schema.json); this narrows it to what the code reviewer sends — never a model

outcome.description: dispatch → MODEL = the wire model, pull env, release on exit; defer → exit 0; refused-before-request (helper rc 2) / fail-closed (rc 3) → the old-proxy fallback with one WARN

legacy.description: the old-proxy fallback's self-routing sites — each is a ⚑ gap until the old proxy retires
